q: QPR reached the quarter-finals of the 1976-77 UEFA Cup, where they went out on penalties. Which club knocked them out?
hint: QPR won the home leg 3-0, lost the away leg 3-0 in Greece, and then lost the shootout 7-6.

q: Which division were QPR playing in when they won the 1967 League Cup?
hint: They won that same division's title in the same season, so the cup came with a promotion.

q: QPR's 1981 artificial pitch was the first in British professional football, and three other Football League clubs followed in the 1980s. Which of these was one of them?
hint: Kenilworth Road got its plastic in 1985; Oldham and Preston laid theirs the year after.

q: In May 2011 an FA commission fined QPR £875,000 over the registration of one of their midfielders, but imposed no points deduction, so the promotion stood. Which midfielder was at the centre of the case?
hint: The Argentine had joined from Instituto in 2009, and the charges that were dismissed concerned third-party ownership rules.

q: QPR came from behind to win the 1967 League Cup final. What was the score at half-time?
hint: Clive Clark scored twice for West Bromwich Albion inside the first 36 minutes.

q: Which QPR midfielder captained England during the mid-1970s?
hint: He led England in eight of his twelve caps before a persistent back injury cut his international career short.
